traits.name: Echolocation
traits.text: A grioth can use its hearing as a precise sense at the listed range.

traits.name: No Breath
traits.text: A grioth doesn't breathe except to speak and is immune to effects that require breathing (such as an inhaled poison).

traits.name: Grioth Venom
traits.text: (emotion, fear, mental, poison); Saving Throw DC 17 Fortitude. Maximum Duration 6 rounds Stage 1 frightened 1 (1 round) Stage 2 frightened 2 (1 round) Stage 3 frightened 3 (1 round)

traits.name: Shock Mind
traits.text: ⬺ (enchantment, mental, occult); The grioth scout makes a Strike with a voidglass weapon. If the Strike hits, it deals an additional 1d6 (1d6) mental damage, and the target must succeed at a DC 17 Will save (this has the incapacitation trait) or become confused for 1 round.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +7 (agile, finesse); Damage 1d4 (1d4) piercing plus grioth venom
